title: UNIQUE: A Unified Retrieval and Ranking System for Large-Scale Feed Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial mobile feed systems rely on a retrieval-ranking pipeline to serve large-scale, heterogeneous, and fast-changing content under strict latency constraints. However, existing pipelines still suffer from two critical issues: hierarchical quantization instability in candidate retrieval and information loss between separated retrieval and ranking stages. These issues hurt long-tail and cold-start recommendation and complicate efficient serving. To address them, we present UNIQUE, a unified retrieval and ranking recommendation framework with single-layer flat quantization. UNIQUE integrates generative code-based retrieval and target-aware ranking into one early-fusion architecture, enabling end-to-end training under a shared representation while preserving efficient candidate generation. A balanced quantization mechanism is further introduced to mitigate codebook imbalance and improve long-tail representation. Offline experiments eva

translated_title: UNIQUE：面向大规模信息流推荐的统一检索与排序系统
translated_abstract: 工业移动信息流系统依赖检索-排序流水线，在严格的延迟约束下服务大规模、异构且快速变化的内容。然而，现有流水线仍然存在两个关键问题：候选检索中的分层量化不稳定性，以及分离的检索与排序阶段之间的信息损失。这些问题损害了长尾和冷启动推荐的效果，并使高效的服务部署变得复杂。为解决这些问题，我们提出了UNIQUE，一个采用单层扁平量化的统一检索与排序推荐框架。UNIQUE将基于生成式编码的检索与目标感知排序整合到同一个早期融合架构中，在共享表示下实现端到端训练，同时保持高效的候选生成。此外，还引入了平衡量化机制，以缓解码本不平衡问题并改善长尾内容的表示。离线实验评估……
tldr: UNIQUE提出了一种将生成式编码检索与目标感知排序融合为单一早期融合架构的统一推荐框架，通过单层扁平量化与平衡量化机制解决了分层量化不稳定和阶段间信息损失问题，显著改善了长尾和冷启动推荐效果。
en_tdlr: UNIQUE is a unified retrieval and ranking recommendation framework that integrates generative code-based retrieval and target-aware ranking into a single early-fusion architecture, using single-layer flat quantization with a balanced quantization mechanism to address hierarchical quantization instability and information loss, thereby improving long-tail and cold-start recommendation.
